title: ASAC, Architettura series: agibilità and national-participation files with plans of the French pavilion (Mostra Internazionale di Architettura 2000-2018)
contents: Per Biennale, the France file with plans (planimetrie/piante), technical reports and conformity declarations: 2000 b. 291/3 (planimetrie); 2002 b. 341 (agibilità, planimetrie); 2006 b. 416/3 (piante) and b. 423/17 (agibilità, planimetrie); 2008 b. 436 (piante); 2010 b. 456 (piante); 2012 b. 469 (piante); 2018 b. 490 fasc. 3 (progetti dell'allestimento)
author: national commissioners / exhibition designers of each year (not stated)
holder: La Biennale di Venezia, ASAC, Fondo storico, serie Architettura
fetch_rule: archive files at ASAC; no online copy
evidence: guard get 200 of https://asac.labiennale.org/pdf/fondo-storico/04-Architettura.pdf -> _work/guard/pages/asac.labiennale.org/26049e0f_04-Architettura.pdf (2.16 MB, 228 pp); text grepped with pymupdf
notes: Agibilità (fitness-for-use) files usually carry the pavilion's survey plan with exits and installations: the most likely place for an as-built plan of the 2000s. Multi-country boxes; France is one file in each.

author: Ateliers Jean Nouvel
